semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-performance electronic materials crucial for semiconductor applications.
summary: Elite Electronic Material (KunShan) Co., Ltd. focuses on the R&D and production of advanced materials such as copper-clad laminates and bonding sheets, which are essential for semiconductor packaging and circuit board applications. The company is recognized for its innovation in halogen-free substrates and high-density interconnects, serving key markets including smartphones and automotive electronics.

regional_presence.China: The company has an R&D center in Kunshan, recognized for its focus on electronic circuit substrates.
